label_description_epic_only.text: Only an epic carries a description.
primary_label_mode_fixed.text: A task type stays a task type. Only other labels can become an epic.
project_not_in_workspace.text: This project is not in one of your workspaces.
project_without_primary_label.text: Every task needs a task type, and the project has none. Add a task type to the project first.
sandbox_gone.text: This sandbox ended before its link was opened. Start a new one from the home page.
sandbox_signed_in.text: Your own account is signed in in this browser, so it opens no sandbox.
sandbox_unavailable.text: Every sandbox for today is taken. Try again tomorrow, or sign up.
sandbox-keep_expired.text: This link to keep your sandbox is no longer valid. Ask for a new one from the sandbox.
sandbox-keep_not_found.text: This link was already used or does not exist. Ask for a new one from the sandbox.
workspace_in_other_organization.text: A project can only go into a workspace of its own organization.
